### Step 1: Fill in your profile information

Tell a bit about yourself, your family, and your home. This will help other parents get to know you better, and decide if you're a good fit for their child.

### Step 2: Set your availability

Let other parents know when you're available to take care of their child. You can set your availability for specific days and times, or for recurring schedules.

### Step 3: Wait for requests

Once you've filled in your profile and set your availability, you can sit back and wait for incoming requests from other parents. You'll receive a notification when someone wants your help.

### Step 4: Confirm incoming request

When you receive a request from another parent, you can review their profile and decide if you're a good fit for their child. If you're interested, you can confirm the request and start chatting with the parent.

### Step 5: Meet the parent and child

Before you start taking care of the child, it's a good idea to meet the parent and child in person. This will help you get to know each other better, and make sure you're both comfortable with the arrangement.
